description: The DTC Wooden 20-inch Carrom Board is a compact and durable board designed for casual indoor play. Perfect for beginners or those with limited space, this board features a sturdy wooden frame and a smooth playing surface to ensure consistent striker glide. description: The ZSA TRADERS UNO Flip Card Game is a high-stakes twist on the classic matching game. This version features a double-sided deck with a "Light Side" and a "Dark Side." name: Gift Collection Harry Potter UNO Card Game
description: The Harry Potter UNO Card Game brings the magic of Hogwarts to the classic matching game. Featuring iconic characters like Harry, Hermione, Ron, and Professor Dumbledore, this edition isn't just a visual makeover—it includes a unique "Wizarding World" twist that can change the course of the game in a single turn. name: Aoko 3-in-1 Board Game Set (Chess, Ludo, Snakes & Ladders)
description: The Aoko Multiple Games Set is a versatile 12x12 inch board game combo that brings three distinct styles of play into one box. It transitions easily from the deep strategy of Chess to the fast-paced luck of Ludo and Snakes & Ladders. This all-in-one kit is designed to provide hours of variety for family nights, house parties, or travel, ensuring there is a game to match every player's mood.

description: A premium paperback edition of the final collection of short stories featuring the world's most famous consulting detective. This edition by Fingerprint! name: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
description: The third installment in J.K. Rowling's legendary series, this paperback edition follows Harry Potter’s third year at Hogwarts. It introduces pivotal characters like Sirius Black and Remus Lupin, shifting the series toward a darker, more complex narrative. This specific edition is published by Bloomsbury, the original home of the Harry Potter series, known for its high-quality paper and iconic cover art.

name: Three Thousand Stitches
description: A collection of 11 heartwarming and inspiring real-life stories from the life of Sudha Murty. The book chronicles her journey from being the only female student in an engineering college to her impactful work with the Infosys Foundation and the devadasi community. This edition is published by Penguin, known for its high-quality paper and minimalist cover design, making it a comfortable read for people of all ages.

name: The Day I Learnt to Fly Again
description: A poignant and inspiring memoir that chronicles a journey of resilience and emotional recovery. The book follows the author's path through personal loss and financial struggle, detailing how she found the strength to rebuild her life from the ground up. This Notion Press edition is crafted for readers seeking hope and motivation, emphasizing that even in the darkest times, self-discovery and faith can lead to a new beginning.

name: Grandma's Bag of Stories
description: A delightful collection of 20 illustrated short stories that capture the magic of a grandmother telling tales to her grandchildren during their summer holidays. The book features traditional Indian folk tales, stories of animals, and moral lessons, all written in Sudha Murty’s signature simple and engaging style. This Puffin edition is specifically designed with large fonts and vibrant illustrations to encourage young readers to develop a love for reading.

name: Great Stories for Children
description: A heartwarming collection of some of Ruskin Bond’s most beloved short stories, specifically curated for young readers. The book is filled with charming tales of animals, eccentric characters, and the serene beauty of the Himalayan foothills. This Rupa Publications edition features a nostalgic cover and clear print, making it an essential addition to any child's library and a perfect introduction to Bond’s gentle storytelling.

name: TRESemmé Keratin Smooth Shampoo
description: The TRESemmé Keratin Smooth Shampoo is a salon-quality formula designed to transform unruly, frizzy hair into sleek, manageable locks. Infused with Keratin and the nourishing power of Argan Oil, it provides a dual-action benefit: smoothing the hair surface while adding deep moisture. This low-sulfate shampoo works to control frizz for up to 3 days, making it the perfect choice for anyone seeking a professional, polished finish and long-lasting shine.

specs.hairType: Frizzy, Dry, and Unmanageable Hair (Safe for Natural & Chemically Treated Hair)
specs.concern: Frizz Control, Intense Smoothness, and Lasting Shine.
specs.ingredients: Formulated with Keratin Protein for structural smoothing and Pure Argan Oil for deep hydration and a silky texture.

name: Dove Intense Repair Conditioner
description: The Dove Intense Repair Conditioner is a deeply nourishing treatment designed to repair both surface-level damage and internal hair structure. Formulated with Fiber Actives, it penetrates the hair fiber to rebuild it from within, while the Micro Moisture Serum smooths and seals the cuticles on the outside. This dual-action formula helps prevent split ends and breakage, leaving hair looking healthy, resilient, and incredibly soft after every wash.

specs.concern: Deep Repair, Breakage Prevention, and Internal Reinforcement.
specs.ingredients: Features Fiber Actives for internal repair and Micro Moisture Serum for external smoothing and shine
